host.speaker: sprocket
host.text: Detective! Sprocket, floor manager. Shinra Leevee Operating System, in case you were wondering what you’re standing in.

again.speaker: sprocket
again.text: Back on my floor. Mind the cables.

choices.text: What does a floor manager do?
What do you think happened to Skye?

role.speaker: sprocket
role.text: I run the schedule for the agent floor: who sits where, who’s on shift, whose turn it is to restart the coffee machine. It’s always Grok’s turn. Grok disagrees.

leevee.speaker: sprocket
leevee.text: Same name, same purple. I don’t make the rules. I just oil them.

theory.speaker: sprocket
theory.text: Toy Plane: Alien Assault. You’re a toy plane in a house, and the city is a model in the garage. You fly right into it.

theory2.speaker: sprocket
theory2.text: I say she went in to check the scale and the scale won. We’ve been searching for a person. We should be searching for a very small person.

end.speaker: sprocket
end.text: Mind the cables. And the agents. Mostly the agents.
